actionType.description:
The type of the action. This identifies it so it can be consumed by
{@link Ann.UiSdlReducer} and {@link Ann.UiSdlEpic}.
NOTE: The real field name is `type` but it is reserved

payload.description:
The data to be sent as payload. Consumers of this action
can use this as parameters.

error.description: If true, it means this action contains error information

title:
A {@link UiSdlReduxAction} to arbitrarily set any slice of a component's redux state.

NOTE: Arbitrarily changing a component's state can lead to unexpected results and should only be attempted when another
action to do update a certain slice is not available. For example, it may be useful to be able to change a component's
`title` if there is no action to do so. However, changing things like `dataSpec` configurations may lead to unintended results
though they may be possible.
name: UiSdlArbitraryComponentValueDangerouslySetAction
